samples.reason: This is a substantial writing task, but it's well-specified with explicit keywords, audience, and content requirements rather than open-ended creative invention. Plover leads on the relevant benchmarks (MMLU-Pro, GPQA, IFEval) which matter for accurate clinical/forensic detail and instruction adherence, and its Summarization/Extraction-adjacent strengths fit a structured, fact-dense article. Both models are comparable on Creative Generation, so Plover's edge on factual accuracy and instruction-following is the deciding factor.
